identificationModule.briefTitle: Surufatinib in Recurrent/Metastatic Head and Neck Adenocarcinomas
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Study of Surufatinib in the Treatment of Recurrent/Metastatic Adenocarcinomas of the Head and Neck

leadSponsor.name: Shanghai Ninth People's Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a non-randomized, phase II, open label study of Surufatinib hydrochloride capsules in recurrent/metastatic adenocarcinomas of head and neck. The primary purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy of anlotinib.

conditions: Head and Neck Cancers - Salivary Gland

interventions.name: Surufatinib
interventions.description: Patients receive oral Surufatinib at a dose of 300mg/d (once-daily dosing continuously, every 28-day treatment cycle), The curative effect was evaluated every 8 weeks.
